current_events: Saudi Arabia's defense ministry reports intercepting drones fired by Iraqi militias backed by Iran from inside Iraq, which targeted oil facilities in eastern Saudi Arabia and the Riyadh area
Saudi Arabia in the 2026 Iran war
The Houthis launch a drone attack that damages the Saudi Abqaiq oil field in the Eastern Province
Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict, Saudi-led intervention in the Yemeni civil war

Drone strikes are reported in El-Obeid, North Kordofan, Sudan, hours after the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) secured the National Export Highway which connects Sudan's capital Khartoum and North Kordofan
The Sudanese Doctors Network reports that the main hospital in the Jebrat al Sheikh District of North Kordofan has been looted and turned into a military barrack
SAF general and leader Abdel Fattah al-Burhan visits the newly captured areas in North Kordofan alongside Sudan Shield Forces leader Abu Aqla Kaikal and Darfur Governor Minni Arko Minnawi

The Gordie Howe International Bridge, which connects between Detroit, Michigan, U.S., and Windsor, Ontario, Canada, officially opens to traffic after months of delay due to the countries' trade war and U.S. imposition of tariffs on Canada
Canada–United States relations
Wildfires continue in the Gironde region near Bordeaux, France, as president Emmanuel Macron describes it as "the worst fire-related crisis since World War II."
Hurricane Genevieve strengthens into a category 5 pacific hurricane, the first in the Pacific region since 2024
The death toll from heavy rains and flooding in Pakistan since June increases to 107 people killed and at least 344 others injured
The General Coordination for Refugees and Displaced Persons in Darfur reports seven cholera cases across the Darfur region in displacement camps between July 5 and July 25
The Lithuanian government registers a resolution to open an embassy in Brasilia, Brazil, in October. The country currently has a consulate-general in São Paulo

Romania recalls its ambassador to Russia, declares a Russian embassy employee persona non grata, and summons Russia's ambassador after three Russian drones violated Romanian airspace between July 24 and 26
Romania–Russia relations, Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war
Chad states its intention to withdraw from the International Criminal Court, citing limited effectiveness and disproportionate attention to African cases
Five people are killed and another is injured in a home invasion and shooting in Gugulethu, Cape Town, South Africa
Three women are wounded in a mass stabbing near the Porte de Clichy station in Paris, France. The perpetrator is detained

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy becomes the first foreign leader to visit the United Kingdom since the new Prime Minister Andy Burnham took office. The two met aboard the HMS Queen Elizabeth, with Burnham reaffirming the UK's support for Ukraine in the ongoing Russo-Ukrainian war
Ukraine–United Kingdom relations
Protests continue for the twelfth day in Ukraine calling for the reinstatement of Ukrainian Minister of Defence Mykhailo Fedorov
